title: Second Serve
description: Lucas battles his inner self-doubt during a decisive tennis match after double-faulting on match point.

scenes.narration: Double-faulting on match point in front of a packed crowd is a nightmare I used to replay every night.
scenes.visual: Teen boy on a tennis court looking down at a tennis ball in disappointment

scenes.narration: For months afterward, every time I served under pressure, my arm would lock up with anxiety.
scenes.visual: Close-up of a teen boy gripping a tennis racket tightly on a court

scenes.narration: During the county quarterfinals, history repeated itself. I was down to my final serve on tiebreak.
scenes.visual: Teen boy bouncing a yellow tennis ball on a blue court surface looking tense

scenes.narration: The crowd was dead silent. I could hear my heart beating louder than the summer heat.
scenes.visual: Low-angle shot of a tennis player standing at the baseline looking focused

scenes.narration: Instead of fearing another mistake, I decided to play to win rather than playing not to lose.
scenes.visual: Teen boy tossing a tennis ball into the air under a bright blue sky

scenes.narration: I tossed the ball high and swung with full confidence. The ball clipped the line for an ace.
scenes.visual: Teen boy celebrating with a pump of his fist on a bright outdoor tennis court

scenes.narration: Confidence isn't the absence of fear, it's trusting yourself anyway. Follow along for more stories every day!
scenes.visual: Teen boy holding his racket over his shoulder smiling warmly at the camera

character_reference: An athletic young adult tennis player with an agile build, short dark brown hair, and a white sweatband on their right wrist. They wear a white short-sleeved athletic polo shirt, dark blue sports shorts, and a white sun visor.
